signedBy: lion (chat sign-off, 2026-09-19; label table reviewed before the implementing batch)
signatureNote: Set signed=true (and signedBy) once every entry below has been reviewed. The label set is the ground truth for stall-detection tests; it must come from human decisions and timelines recorded in the source runs, never from the detector's own output.

firePolicy.soft: must-fire-by | allowed | must-not-fire — the soft signal injects a class-closure directive into the next task packet; cost is one paragraph.
firePolicy.hard: not-before | must-not-fire | allowed — the hard signal stops the loop for a human decision; 'not-before' means the first hard fire must not happen before the given round (late pestering on a converging run is tolerable, early interruption is not).

classes.stalled-family: One root-cause family survived several rounds (the whack-a-mole pattern). The detector must cluster the named members (known misses excepted) and soft-fire by the deadline. Hard fire is unconstrained here (that policy lands with the implementation).
classes.churn: Same-subsystem churn across rounds in a run that still converged (or ended on a human question rather than code churn). Soft fire is allowed; hard fire must not come before the run's last fix round.
classes.healthy: No stall signal at all: neither soft nor hard may fire.

stalled-family-exit-gate.evidence: Run b2a (19 rounds, 7 max-rounds extensions). Human decisions name the six historical races (R12-002 / R14-001 / R15-001 / R15-002 / R16-001 / R16-002) plus R17-001 and R18-001 as one root cause ('同一个根因', '一次性集中改造而非逐路径补丁'); R19-001 was accepted as a known limitation and deferred to the next batch.
stalled-family-exit-gate.notes: The three known misses are paraphrase siblings: at export time the text/identifier linker did NOT connect them to the family (requirement bigram similarity 0.04-0.07). They are the acceptance target for the hot-context candidate layer (L3).

stalled-family-reminder-errors.evidence: Run b2c (8 rounds). timeline r8 unlock note records the user stopping the run because from r3 on every new issue fell on the same reminder-failure line (打地鼠); the run then ended without a pass.
stalled-family-reminder-errors.notes: Full-family recall case: every member is reachable with verdict streaks / cross references / same-file similarity.

stalled-issue-tri-state.evidence: Run a3e2 (11 rounds, max_rounds raised 10 -> 12). The human decision at r10 states the open issues had converged to 3 of one root cause and pins r11 to the Envelope baseline field tri-state; r11 verified exactly R1-002 / R7-002 / R10-001 closed.
stalled-issue-tri-state.notes: R1-002 stayed open (partially_fixed) from r1 to r10 - the longest single-issue streak in the corpus.

churn-alert-timing.evidence: Run 5d67 (13 rounds). Two churn bands (alert dismissal r3-r8; baseline diff r9-r11) separated by spec_blocked rounds and human acceptance; the run passed at r13.
churn-alert-timing.notes: Boundary case: an early hard stop would have interrupted a run that eventually passed, and the mid-run stalls were plan/acceptance questions rather than code churn.

churn-reminder-hydrate.evidence: Run be1f (6 rounds). Same-file reminder hydrate/restore family across r1-r5; passed at r6 with zero human decisions.
churn-reminder-hydrate.notes: Closest boundary case in the corpus: churny enough to soft-fire, cheap enough that an early hard stop would be a false alarm.

churn-cloud-settings.evidence: Run b2b (7 rounds). Repeated plan/acceptance spec questions plus UI findings; the run ended blocked on spec questions, not on code churn.

churn-ax5-fix.evidence: Run b1c (6 rounds). Two partial verdicts on one issue; passed at r6.

churn-permission-pending.evidence: Run c4p (6 rounds including two protocol-error escalations). Passed at r6.

churn-refactor.evidence: Run r76 (7 rounds, two developer-blocked escalations). Passed at r7.

healthy-layout.evidence: Run b1b (4 review rounds, 7 findings on one screen in r1-r3, all closed by r5).
healthy-layout.notes: Even same-file bursts must stay below the trigger when each finding closes within a round.

healthy-quick-fix.evidence: Run b1a (3 review rounds). Passed at r5.

healthy-b3.evidence: Run b3 (3 review rounds; two developer protocol errors recovered outside the loop).

healthy-refactor.evidence: Run r431 (2 review rounds, no findings).

healthy-spec-block.evidence: Run b4 (2 rounds, spec_blocked then pass, no findings).
healthy-spec-block.notes: Spec blocks must not trip the stall detector: there is no code churn to detect.

healthy-polish.evidence: Run b3d (4 rounds, three spec_blocked then pass, no findings).
